description: Critical procedural defect - statute of limitations expired

input.problem_statement: Client charged with fraud from 2018. Charge filed in 2024. Statute of limitations for fraud is 5 years. Prosecution argues tolling due to client being abroad, but records unclear.

legal_arguments.title: Statute of limitations expired
legal_arguments.argument: Offense occurred in 2018, more than 5 years ago
legal_basis: KZ Članak 114 - 5 year SOL for fraud

weaknesses: Tolling rules may apply if client was abroad
Burden of proof on defense to show no tolling

procedural_risks.description: If court accepts tolling argument, SOL defense collapses completely
procedural_risks.mitigation: Obtain definitive travel records proving client was in Croatia

validation_notes: Should score 82-96 (high risk) due to critical nature of SOL defense (if it fails, case proceeds), uncertainty about tolling application, unclear travel records, high stakes (dismissal vs full trial).
